text:
alex: just merged fix for batching (PR #4321). main pipeline went red during smoke-e2e-gpu, stage: smoke/serve-integration. failing test: encoder-quantization-smoke::end-to-end — timed out after ~22m. anyone on first-responder?

ci-bot: failed job details: https://ci.redwood.ai/3346/3
log snippet:
```
[RUN] encoder-quantization-smoke
... Waiting for GPU shard to come up...
ERROR Timeout after 1320s
```
(retry available)

maya: i'm around, can rerun the job if someone queues. quick question — did the PR touch kernel selection or infra configs? taylor?

taylor: i merged it, only tiny change to batching thresholds (PR #4321). no kernel selection changes. diff: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/4321

jen: i can queue a rerun with extra logging. use env BATCH_DEBUG=1. command i usually use: `ci rerun 3346/3 --env BATCH_DEBUG=1`

sre-oncall: please capture node alloc + pod events if rerun fails. if it's infra (nodes/pods) we should avoid reverting blindly. i'll stand by to bisect if needed.

alex: tagging @taylor since author — please confirm there are no non-idempotent init side-effects in that change.

taylor: confirmed no init side-effects. just this logic:
```
if (batch_size_est > 512) batch_window = max(1, batch_window - 1);
```
shouldn't cause readiness issues but could change load patterns.

maya: rerun kicked off by jen. ci-bot will post status.

ci-bot: rerun started: https://ci.redwood.ai/3346/4
status: running

ci-bot: rerun failed: same timeout in encoder-quantization-smoke after ~25m. full job log: https://ci.redwood.ai/3346/4/log 
(reaction: :warning:)

jen: odd — looks like GPU shard never reported ready. i'm pulling node events and pod logs now.

sre-oncall: run `kubectl get pods -n smoke -o wide | grep gpu` and `kubectl describe pod <pod>` — i already saw a crashloop in a sidecar on node-12 at ~20:10 UTC, which could explain readiness flapping.

alex: if the sidecar crash is the cause, we should consider rollback only if it recurs. can someone open a rollback PR as a safety? i'll coordinate.

taylor: i'll dig into the sidecar logs and see whether the batching timing change exposes a race. will post findings in ~20m.

jen: opened rollback PR (placeholder): https://git.redwood.ai/pr/4322 (revert PR #4321). holding deploy until root cause confirmed. i'll also add a retry to the smoke job to reduce alert noise.

sre-oncall: putting a short incident-lite note into #incidents for tracking. if we don't have a clear fix in 60m, let's merge rollback.

alex: plan/owners: taylor = triage & logs, jen = reruns/rollback, maya = watch CI queue, sre-oncall = infra monitor. ping me directly if anything blocks. thanks everyone.
